name: Titagarh Rail Systems Ltd.
about: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited manufactures and sells freight and passenger rail systems in India and internationally. The company offers forged wheel set, cast bogies, couplers, draft gear, loco shells, and cast manganese steel crossing products; flat, hopper, tank, box, automobile-carrying, covered, and special purpose wagons; and brake vans. It also provides passenger rolling stock products, including semi high-speed trains, electric multiple unit train sets, urban metro rail system - aluminum and stainless steel; and propulsion and electrical equipment, such as propulsion systems, traction motors, auxiliary power supply products, electronic equipment, traction converters and power electronics, train control and monitoring systems, and hardware and software products. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~35% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~5% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.7% cost of equity).
PE of 45 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 92), though that is a short history to judge by.
